# ASTP — AI State Tree Protocol — Documentation

> ASTP is an open protocol for **cognitive persistence** and **verifiable
> cognition** in multi-agent systems: it records that an agent reasoned, what
> state resulted, and makes that record cryptographically verifiable and
> re-interpretable. Bring your own cognitive architecture.

Most ASTP implementations are done by AI coding agents. This file, the
companion AGENTS.md, and the ASTP Docs MCP server exist so those agents
implement the protocol from its normative text instead of guessing (which
produces non-conforming adapters).

## Implementing the protocol

- Prefer the **ASTP Docs MCP server** for exact lookups — it returns
  governance rules, conformance vectors, sections, and hash preimages verbatim
  with citations: `search_spec`, `get_governance_rule` (G-1..G-40),
  `get_conformance_vectors` (e.g. RP-009 or a family like RP), `get_section`,
  `get_hash_preimage`, `get_test_vectors` (the machine-readable expected digests),
  `corpus_info`.
- Hash preimages, field order, and governance rules are **normative and exact**
  — read them, do not infer them. A wrong field set or order produces a
  different content hash and a non-conforming implementation.

## Normative documents (open corpus)

- SPEC.md — the canonical protocol specification, 5.2.0 (§1–§22; governance G-1..G-40)
- CONFORMANCE-REPRODUCIBILITY.md — seal constructions and reproducibility (RP-*), with vectors/5.0.0/seal-constructions.json
- GLOSSARY.md — every term, reconciled with the SPEC
- GOVERNANCE.md / VERSIONING.md — how the protocol changes; Episodes of Record
- docs/RATIFICATION-5.0.0.md — the 5.0.0 Episode of Record statement
- CONFORMANCE-BFM.md — §19 branch/fork/merge, asides, soliloquies
- CONFORMANCE-CROSS-EPISODE-LINKING.md — §20 cross-episode linking and grouping
- CONFORMANCE-LAYER3.md — §21 Workflow & Execution DAG
- IMPLEMENTATION-PHASE3.md / CONFORMANCE.md — §16 trust infrastructure (keys, anchoring, witnesses, chain proofs)

The protocol names storage roles, not providers (SPEC §12.1). Storage-layout guides for §19–§21 are a deployment's, not the protocol's, and ship with the reference deployment's adapter rather than in this corpus.
- GLOSSARY.md, CHANGELOG.md, VERSIONING.md

## Optional

- A public web assistant (Clotho-lite) answers questions grounded in these same
  documents, citing the same passages the MCP server returns.
